newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Consultations to hold Egypt, Syria, Jordan summit to discuss developments in Iraq and Gulf.
- UAE textile exports put at 1.5 billion dirhams.
- No change in war risk cover premiums for ships in the Gulf after U.S. fires cruise missiles at Iraqi targets.
- UAE markets, sea and air traffic unaffected by U.S missile attacks.
- UAE supports Comprehensive nuclear Test Ban Treaty draft resolution.
- Arab Monetary Fund meets in Abu Dhabi.
